title: The Silkworm Ribbon Exchange
description: At the midsummer exchange, villagers bring empty spools to the mulberry orchard. A seamstress offers a loop of purple silk in return.
alt: A seamstress offers a purple silk loop to a pale silkworm on a branch above a workbench with spools in a mulberry orchard.
pairing: A midsummer ribbon exchange × silkworms that spin directly onto spools
